title: A second reduction-type formula for the refined Littlewood--Richardson coefficients in type A
summary: For a permutation $w$ in the symmetric group $S_n$ and partitions $λ, μ, ν$ with at most $n$ parts, the refined Littlewood--Richardson (LR) coefficients $c^ν_{λ,μ}(w)$ in type $A_n$ count the multiplicity of the irreducible polynomial representation $V(ν)$ of the general linear algebra $\mathfrak{gl}_n(\mathbb{C})$ appearing in the decomposition of the Kostant--Kumar submodule $K(λ,w,μ)$ of the tensor product $V(λ) \otimes V(μ)$ of two irreducible polynomial $\mathfrak{gl}_n(\mathbb{C})$-modules.
